ns2:section.sectionText: International Civil Liberties: Freedom of Expression (3 credit hours) - Professor Murray (Law) The course will examine civil liberties involving freedom of expression and association from a global, international, and comparative perspective. It will examine the nature and level of the freedoms afforded, and the problems of censorship, restraints, and oppression. The course will invite discussion of specific problems and will examine legal and public policy solutions from a cross-cultural, national, and transnational perspective.
